nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set in Owned constructor from msg.sender; gates onlyOwner functions.
Declared but unused address state variable intended for ownership transfer.
ERC20 token symbol, set to TRVLR in constructor.
ERC20 token name, set to TRVLR in constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in constructor and increased in _mint.
Mapping of account balances; written by transfer, transferFrom and _mint.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; written by approve, approveAndCall, transferFrom.
SafeMath addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow guard.
SafeMath division with division-by-zero guard.
Abstract callback implemented by arbitrary external contracts; invoked by approveAndCall.
Owned constructor setting owner = msg.sender.
TRVLR constructor that sets metadata, mints the whole supply to a shadowed local owner variable and emits Transfer.
View function returning _totalSupply.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender; uses safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without return-value or reentrancy guard.
Spends allowance and moves balances using safeSub/safeAdd.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then makes an external call to spender.receiveApproval(...) with user-controlled spender, tokens and data.
onlyOwner mint that increases _totalSupply and balances[account] and emits Transfer.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
onlyOwner function performing an external IERC20.transfer call on an arbitrary tokenAddress.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowances.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, address(this), data) with arbitrary spender, executed before state is finalised and without a reentrancy guard.
External call IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a user-supplied token contract; return value is propagated unchecked.
Arithmetic mutation _totalSupply += amount inside _mint.
Arithmetic mutation balances[account] += amount inside _mint.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Token amount parameter of transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve, written into allowed.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
User-controlled address used as both allowance key and external call target in approveAndCall.
Token amount parameter of approveAndCall, forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary calldata parameter forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
Beneficiary account parameter of _mint, validated against address(0).
Mint amount parameter of _mint added to _totalSupply and balances.
Source address parameter of transferFrom whose balance is decreased.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom deducted from balance and allowance.
Arbitrary token contract address used as the external call target in transferAnyERC20Token.
Amount parameter forwarded to the external IERC20.transfer call.
Account address parameter of balanceOf used to index balances.
Owner address parameter of allowance used to index allowed.
Spender address parameter of allowance used to index allowed.
Local variable 'address owner = owner' inside TRVLR constructor that shadows the inherited owner state variable.

edges.reason: owner is initialised from msg.sender, so the first caller becomes the privileged owner.
Owned constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
TRVLR constructor reads owner to assign the initial supply.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to 1000000e18.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole supply.
Constructor local variable shadows the inherited owner state variable, obscuring which owner is used.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
transfer mutates balances for sender and recipient.
transfer uses safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender].
transfer uses safeAdd to credit balances[to].
Recipient parameter controls the credited balance in transfer.
Amount parameter controls the debited/credited amounts in transfer.
Msg.sender is debited in transfer.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
spender parameter becomes the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter becomes the allowance value in approve.
Msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
transferFrom mutates both sender and recipient balances.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient.
from parameter selects the debited balance in transferFrom.
to parameter selects the credited balance in transferFrom.
tokens parameter controls the transferred amount in transferFrom.
Msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is reduced in transferFrom.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
spender parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
Msg.sender is the allowance owner set in approveAndCall.
spender parameter becomes both the allowance key and the external call target.
tokens parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
data parameter is arbitrary user-controlled calldata forwarded to the external call.
approveAndCall reaches the untrusted external call with no reentrancy guard and no return-value handling.
Attacker-controlled spender determines the contract address that is called.
Attacker-controlled tokens value is passed to the untrusted callee.
Attacker-controlled data payload is passed to the untrusted callee.
The external call invokes the attacker-controlled implementation of receiveApproval.
receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall/transfer while allowance and balances are still inconsistent.
_mint is gated by onlyOwner, comparing msg.sender against owner.
Msg.sender must equal owner for the onlyOwner check in _mint to pass.
_mint executes the _totalSupply += amount arithmetic mutation.
_totalSupply is increased by an owner-supplied amount.
_mint executes the balances[account] += amount arithmetic mutation.
balances[account] is increased by an owner-supplied amount.
account parameter is the mint beneficiary and checked against address(0).
amount parameter controls supply and balance increases in _mint.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on a caller-chosen contract before returning.
tokenAddress parameter determines the untrusted contract that is called.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the untrusted IERC20.transfer call.
A malicious tokenAddress implementation can re-enter the token during transferAnyERC20Token.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only exists to supply transfer's recipient argument.
The 'tokens' parameter only exists to supply transfer's amount argument.
The 'spender' parameter only exists to key the allowance write in approve.
The 'tokens' parameter only exists as the allowance value in approve.
The 'spender' parameter of approveAndCall is the user-controlled external call target.
The 'tokens' parameter of approveAndCall is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The 'data' parameter of approveAndCall is raw attacker-controlled calldata.
The 'account' parameter of _mint is the beneficiary of the minted balance.
The 'amount' parameter of _mint drives the supply and balance arithmetic.
The 'from' parameter of transferFrom selects the debited balance.
The 'to' parameter of transferFrom selects the credited balance.
The 'tokens' parameter of transferFrom controls the spent amount.
The 'tokenAddress' parameter of transferAnyERC20Token is the untrusted call target.
The 'tokens' parameter of transferAnyERC20Token is the amount sent to the external token.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter of balanceOf is only a mapping index.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter of allowance is only a mapping index.
The 'spender' parameter of allowance is only a mapping index.
The shadowing local 'owner' exists only inside the TRVLR constructor and collapses into it.
